# provider::docker::compose_env

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: function. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Turns a map of environment variables into a list of `KEY=VALUE` strings sorted by key, the form of env files, compose `environment` lists and the Engine API `Env` field. A null value yields a bare `KEY` (inherited, as in compose). Empty keys and keys containing `=` are an error.

## Usage

```terraform
provider::docker::compose_env(env map(string)) list(string)
```

## Parameters

| Position | Name | Type | Null allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `env` | `map(string)` |  | Variables, e.g. `{ LOG_LEVEL = "info" }`. |

Returns `list(string)`. Provider functions need Terraform >= 1.8.

## Example

```terraform
locals {
  app_env = {
    LOG_LEVEL = "info"
    DB_HOST   = "db"
    HOME      = null # bare "HOME": inherited
  }

  # ["DB_HOST=db", "HOME", "LOG_LEVEL=info"]
  env_lines = provider::docker::compose_env(local.app_env)
}

# An env file for the application, shipped as a swarm config.
resource "docker_config" "app_env" {
  name = "app.env"
  data = base64encode(join("", [for l in local.env_lines : "${l}\n"]))
}
```
